essence: Abandoning hard-to-abandon lives leads to dissolution in supreme Shiva.
The killing of such a one brings welfare to many and merit to him.
The command declares that this must never be spoken.
One should never perform god-like recitation before a śūdra.
Kula substances and related matters should not be spoken in the presence of a paśu.
